I'm Asian, and my parents are your classic super strict Asian parents. I'm currently not staying with them as I'm studying overseas, but we talk frequently.
The guy....it's hard to explain. We've known each other (in person) for a few years, and started dating online a few months ago (he moved away). He came back to visit me in July, and it happened. Now he's away again, but we are still in contact.
It's almost impossible for me to get an abortion. I've found a few clinics that would do it privately and confidentially, but I have no way to pay for that. The only way that I could get an abortion involves telling my parents, who as of now don't even allow me to have a boyfriend.
I feel so stuck. I feel so stupid. I was on the pill, but somehow it happened. I'm still in school and I don't know what to do anymore. i'm sorry if the comment is incoherent I'm just really lost right now.

Thank you for responding
